basic_info.chief_complaint: He came to our hospital for treatment with swelling and pain on his left cheek.

chief_complaint.chief_complaint: He came to our hospital for treatment with swelling and pain on his left cheek.

oral_examination.oral_examination: 38 The left cheek is swollen, and the mouth opening is limited to less than three fingers. The mucosa around the left lower wisdom tooth in the mouth is red and swollen, soft and swollen to touch.

diagnosis.primary: 38 Treatment plan 8 for acute pericoronitis (K05.204) recommends extraction after anti-inflammation. Today, the pus was drained and drained, and the CBCT showed that the distal coronal part was dark, and the apical part was close to the mandibular nerve canal.

source_handle: 38 Explain the condition, treatment plan, cost, prognosis, etc. to the patient, and the patient is informed and agrees to the treatment. Local disinfection was performed with 0.5% iodophor, a horizontal incision was made at the buccal vestibular sulcus, pus was drained under pressure, a drainage strip was placed, and 0.9% NaCL was used for irrigation.
